title: Create or refine the artwork
guidance:
For new work, generate a promising direction from the brief using a current image model. Compare a few distinct directions when there is a real design question to resolve. For an existing direction, make focused edits instead of starting over. Judge the artwork itself before relying on a decorative product mockup.

The methods below can be operated by an agent using the tools and connections available in its environment. Consult the linked provider documentation for current capabilities.

options.title: Generate a logo direction
options.summary: Call an available image model with the design brief. Inspect the returned artwork, select the strongest direction, and carry that image into refinement.
options.when: A new direction is needed and an image-generation method is available to the agent.

options.title: Refine existing artwork
options.summary: Provide the current image to an editing method. Specify the exact change and what must remain consistent: silhouette, icon/wordmark relationship, type character, or color. Inspect the returned image for drift.
options.when: A useful draft or existing raster logo is available and the agent can operate an image-editing method.

options.title: Edit existing vector artwork
options.summary: Use a connected vector/design tool or edit the SVG source to make the required adjustment. Preserve the established geometry and typography; verify the resulting artwork.
options.when: The existing editable vector identity should be preserved or a real output requirement needs vector work.
